# Mohamed Ali (محمد علي) | Full-Stack Developer & Backend Software Engineer

This is the official portfolio website of Mohamed Ali (محمد علي), a professional Full-Stack Developer and Backend-Focused Software Engineer specializing in Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Docker containerization, AWS cloud deployments, and AI integration.
